source_of_truth: Registered windows and the interaction contracts currently implemented in this repository.

screens.title: Task hub
screens.purpose: Launch the plugin's main workflows from three grouped tabs.
screens.coverage_note: All thirteen action-button routes, the Close action, the three notebook views, window creation, and interactive-control inventory are exercised against the real Tk widgets. Downstream KiCad operations have separate integration tests and are not implied by this component-level coverage.

screens.title: Functional Block Library
screens.purpose: Search registered block libraries, inspect facade and schematic previews, choose implementations, configure a block, and start placement.
screens.coverage_note: The production browser is captured in both themes and has targeted unit/integration coverage for search, selection, preview rendering, and placement hand-off. Its complete toolbar action set is not yet registered as execute-and-assert contracts.
functionality: Search and filter the registered block list
Switch between facade and schematic previews
Select an implementation and sheet
Refresh records and manage library roots
Place a facade or open implementation, facade, and PCB layout managers

screens.title: Place Functional Block chooser
screens.purpose: Search for a block, choose profile and variant settings, and return a fully specified placement selection.
screens.coverage_note: A real Tk/X11 GUI test drives the production chooser with keyboard input and asserts the selected block. Full contracts for every selector, cancel path, and error state remain to be added.
functionality: Filter available blocks
Choose a profile and implementation
Render the native KiCad facade preview
Return the selected record, variant, profile, and typed parameters

screens.title: Instance configuration
screens.purpose: Change the selected schematic instance's profile, implementation, typed parameters, and PCB layout.
screens.coverage_note: A GUI test exercises profile selection and the resulting schematic update. Every control, invalid value, stale instance, and rollback path is not yet covered by component contracts.
functionality: Select a profile or a custom configuration
Choose an implementation and PCB layout
Edit typed parameter values
Save one undoable schematic update or cancel

screens.title: Record picker
screens.purpose: Choose one block record for an action that operates on a library entry.
screens.coverage_note: Selection and empty-library behavior have unit tests, but the full window interaction and every button/key path are not yet covered by UI contracts.
functionality: Search and filter records
Select a record and confirm
Cancel without changing the selected object
Exercise empty and single-record libraries

screens.title: Create Functional Block
screens.purpose: Name a block extracted from a selected hierarchical sheet and provide its description.
screens.coverage_note: The production form is captured in both themes and the extraction/IPC flow has end-to-end tests. Form validation, cancellation, and every control are not yet registered as UI contracts.
functionality: Display the selected source sheet
Enter the required block name and optional description
Create or cancel without leaving partial library files

screens.title: Manage Libraries
screens.purpose: Register, create, change, and remove shared library roots.
screens.coverage_note: The library-root manager is captured and has domain-level coverage for root configuration. Native chooser cancellation and all UI action outcomes are not yet contract-tested.
functionality: Add or create a library root
Change the selected root folder
Remove a registration without deleting library data
Choose the default library root

screens.title: Open implementation chooser
screens.purpose: Select which named circuit implementation to open in the schematic editor.
screens.coverage_note: The chooser is implemented as a transient Tk window in the functional block browser. It is not yet in the visual screenshot inventory or a reusable execute-and-assert component contract.
functionality: Show available default and named implementations for the selected block
Return the selected implementation to the editor-open workflow
Cancel without opening a document

screens.title: Open PCB layout chooser
screens.purpose: Select a stored PCB layout to open in PCB Editor.
screens.coverage_note: The chooser is implemented as a transient Tk window in the functional block browser. It is not yet in the visual screenshot inventory or a reusable execute-and-assert component contract.
functionality: Show stored PCB layouts for the selected block
Return the selected layout to the editor-open workflow
Cancel without opening a board

screens.title: Implementations manager
screens.purpose: Review the single Default implementation row and maintain named alternatives.
screens.coverage_note: The real manager is captured in both themes and variant data mutations have unit coverage. Add/edit/promote/remove controls are not yet all executed through UI contracts.
functionality: Review the Default implementation and named alternatives
Add or edit an implementation
Promote a named implementation to Default
Remove an alternative while preserving profile/layout constraints

screens.title: Implementation details
screens.purpose: Define a named implementation and choose how its schematic source is created.
screens.coverage_note: The real dialog is captured in both themes. Its source mode, file chooser, validation, and cancel behavior still need contracts.
functionality: Enter a variant selector
Choose blank, existing-file, or copy-from-implementation mode
Confirm or cancel without creating partial files

screens.title: PCB Layout Manager
screens.purpose: Maintain stored PCB layouts, default selection, and implementation associations.
screens.coverage_note: The manager is captured in both themes and layout/model changes have substantial unit coverage. The full UI state matrix and persistence failure paths do not yet have component contracts.
functionality: Add, remove, or set a layout as Default
Assign a layout to one or more implementations
Refresh the table after mutations
Persist accepted changes and report write failures

screens.title: Add PCB layout
screens.purpose: Create a blank board or import an existing board as a stored block layout.
screens.coverage_note: Both blank-board and existing-file dialog modes are captured. The Add, file-picker, validation, rollback, and open-result paths need execute-and-assert contracts.
functionality: Enter a layout name
Create a blank board or browse for an existing KiCad board
Associate the layout with an implementation
Save and open the stored board

screens.title: Error, confirmation, and report dialogs
screens.purpose: Explain blocked operations, recoverable errors, destructive confirmations, and completed reports.
screens.coverage_note: Dialog behavior is covered selectively by existing operation tests. There is no exhaustive cross-action dialog contract or standard generated dialog inventory yet.
functionality: Assert an error is visible and identifies the failed operation
Assert a confirmation includes the consequence and cancel path
Assert completed actions report through the expected passive feedback channel
Assert error handling does not silently leave partial files or registrations

screens.title: KiCad editors and native file choosers
screens.purpose: Open and focus KiCad-owned schematic, symbol, and PCB documents, or select files using the operating system's native dialogs.
screens.coverage_note: Some Eeschema and PCB hand-offs have real integration coverage. Cross-platform native window ownership, Symbol Editor selection, and every native file chooser outcome are not established by the current Linux/X11 tests.
functionality: Launch or focus the correct KiCad editor and document
Preserve the selected library item or project context
Test native file/directory chooser filters, initial paths, and cancellation
Separate proven IPC behavior from platform-specific window-manager behavior
